objects.description: Upon execution, [Metamorfo](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0455) has unzipped itself after being downloaded to the system and has performed string decryption.(Citation: Medium Metamorfo Apr 2020)(Citation: FireEye Metamorfo Apr 2018)(Citation: ESET Casbaneiro Oct 2019)
objects.description_fa: پس از اجرا، [Metamorfo](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0455) پس از بارگیری در سیستم، خود را از حالت فشرده خارج کرد و رمزگشایی رشته را انجام داد.(Citation: Medium Metamorfo Apr 2020)(Citation: FireEye Metamorfo Apr 2018)[[[CTI_PRESERVE_2]] (Citation: ESET Casbaneiro Oct 2019)
